recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-22129 unless Vocabulary later changes the semantics of ConceptMap.group.unmapped.
issue_request: FHIR-22129 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request for FHIR-core ConceptMap. It requested a new optional ConceptMap.group.unmapped.relationship code element with required binding to ConceptMapRelationship and a constraint requiring relationship when unmapped.mode is not other-map.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites git 8b0904bd2f, which added cmd-9 and ConceptMap2.group.unmapped.relationship to the then-active R5 ConceptMap2 source. Later history renamed ConceptMap2 back to ConceptMap, and the current ConceptMap StructureDefinition retains the requested element and invariant.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has active ConceptMap resource, work group, and status entries, so source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml is in current core build scope. The current wording uses the evolved R5/R6 mode name use-source-code and the current unversioned concept-map-relationship value set URL, but those differences preserve the accepted semantics. Confluence minutes confirm FHIR-22129 was part of the March 2021 Vocabulary ConceptMap R5 tracker set, and no direct Zulip discussion was found that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source defines ConceptMap.group.unmapped.relationship as a 0..1 code, marks it with condition cmd-9, binds it required to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/concept-map-relationship, and defines cmd-9 on ConceptMap.group.unmapped as (mode != 'other-map') implies relationship.exists().
